# Colecto v0.5.2

Adding an account is now a short wizard that finds your server settings from your
email address.

## Adding an account

- **Three steps instead of one long form.** Enter your email address, check the server
  settings, then glance over a short summary before saving. **Back** takes you to any
  earlier step without losing what you typed. If you change the address, only the
  fields you never edited are updated.
- **Settings filled in for you.** Colecto looks up your provider's IMAP, SMTP and JMAP
  settings. It uses its own list of popular providers (Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail,
  GMX, mailbox.org, Posteo, Zoho, Yandex and AOL), Thunderbird Autoconfig, Thunderbird's
  provider database, DNS records, and JMAP discovery. A note on the second step says
  which of these it used. For lesser-known domains, Thunderbird's database learns the
  domain, but never your full address. See
  [Finding server settings](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.5.2/docs/accounts.md#finding-server-settings).
- **Clear answers for providers Colecto can't use.** Outlook.com only allows OAuth
  sign-in and Tuta has no IMAP, so the wizard says so up front. Proton Mail fills in
  Proton Mail Bridge's defaults.
- **Any port, one click for the usual ones.** Each server shows its common ports, plus
  an **Other** box for any port. The summary flags likely mistakes, such as port 25
  for sending, before you save.
